description: Governance rules for when reruns are permitted, required, and blocked. Prevents spurious reruns and enforces convergence discipline.

ELIGIBLE.condition: A scenario has GENERATION_FAILED or BUILD_FAILED and a new constraint fix has been applied since the last run.

NEEDS_FIX_FIRST.condition: A scenario has GENERATION_FAILED or BUILD_FAILED but NO new constraint has been applied.
NEEDS_FIX_FIRST.action: Rerun BLOCKED until root cause is identified and at least one REQUIRED or FORBIDDEN constraint is added/modified.

BLOCKED_PERMANENTLY.condition: A type has been classified as PERMANENTLY_BLOCKED (e.g., API_ACCESS_PARADOX, NO_PUBLIC_CONSTRUCTOR with all instance methods).
BLOCKED_PERMANENTLY.action: Rerun BLOCKED. Requires external change (new package version, new API surface). Document in backlog.
BLOCKED_PERMANENTLY.escalation: Require Aspose version upgrade or API design change from vendor.

ALREADY_CONVERGED.condition: A scenario is PR_DRY_RUN_READY or POST_MERGE_VERIFIED.
ALREADY_CONVERGED.action: Rerun NOT PERMITTED unless package version changes or explicit override with justification.

Optimizer.next_action: Run 2nd consecutive reviewer pass; if PASS → PR eligible

Processor.next_action: Investigate ProcessorContext factory; check Aspose.Words version changelog for public constructor addition

rerun_discipline_rules.rule: Never rerun a converged scenario without a package version change or an explicit override.
rerun_discipline_rules.rationale: Non-determinism in LLM means rerunning a passing scenario risks a non-deterministic regression. Preserve the authoritative run artifact.

rerun_discipline_rules.rule: Never add a NEEDS_FIX_FIRST type to a rerun batch. Fix constraints first, then rerun.
rerun_discipline_rules.rationale: Repeated runs without constraint changes consume LLM quota and produce the same failure. Root cause must be identified before each retry.

rerun_discipline_rules.rule: When a repair regression is observed (a type that was PASS in run N is FAIL in run N+1), add all structural patterns as REQUIRED: before the next run.
rerun_discipline_rules.rationale: Repair re-injects only REQUIRED: constraints. Structural patterns in template_hints are lost during repair. A regression indicates a structural pattern was not promoted.

rerun_discipline_rules.rule: Maximum 2 build repair rounds per scenario per run. If scenario still fails after 2 repairs, mark GENERATION_FAILED and add to NEEDS_FIX_FIRST.
rerun_discipline_rules.rationale: More than 2 repair rounds indicates the root cause is a missing constraint, not a transient LLM error. Additional rounds waste quota.

rerun_discipline_rules.rule: Before each new pilot run, load failure-pattern-registry.json and verify that all known FP-* patterns have corresponding constraints in the family config.
rerun_discipline_rules.rationale: Prevents re-discovering the same failures in new runs.
